sentiment.rationale: This pre-earnings digest describes elevated market expectations heading into United's FQ4 2025 print: bullish analyst sentiment, rising price targets, and a consensus full-year 2026 EPS modeled up ~23.9% year-over-year. The bar is high, with the digest noting the market's focus is on whether management's initial 2026 guide will validate the already-priced-in bullish thesis, leaving little room for a soft print. This stretched positioning raises the risk of a negative surprise reaction, warranting a bearish sentiment score.
